title: Sprint 8 - Subqueries, String Functions & CTEs
description: Complete all SQL queries in this sprint.

tickets.title: Overdue Tasks
tickets.description: Find all tasks where the due_date is in the past.
tasks: Find all tasks where the due_date is in the past.
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT * FROM todos WHERE due_date < date('now') ORDER BY id;

solution.query.sql: SELECT * FROM todos WHERE due_date < date('now');

tickets.title: String Functions
tickets.description: Select the `username` in uppercase, the length of the `email`, the first 3 characters of the `status` (SUBSTR), and the `title` with any surrounding spaces removed (TRIM) from `users` and `todos` (joined).
tasks: Select the `username` in uppercase, the length of the `email`, the first 3 characters of the `status` (SUBSTR), and the `title` with any surrounding spaces removed (TRIM) from `users` and `todos` (joined).
learning_objectives: Use UPPER, LOWER, LENGTH, SUBSTR, TRIM.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT UPPER(u.username), LENGTH(u.email), SUBSTR(t.status, 1, 3), TRIM(t.title) FROM users u JOIN todos t ON u.id = t.user_id ORDER BY u.username, t.title;

tickets.title: Task Urgency Levels
tickets.description: Output the title of the task and a new column called 'urgency'. If priority is 1, urgency is 'High', otherwise 'Normal'.
tasks: Output the title of the task and a new column called 'urgency'. If priority is 1, urgency is 'High', otherwise 'Normal'.
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT title, CASE WHEN priority = 1 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS urgency FROM todos ORDER BY title;

solution.query.sql:
SELECT title, 
  CASE 
    WHEN priority = 1 THEN 'High' 
    ELSE 'Normal' 
  END AS urgency 
FROM todos;
